newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat to meet President Weizman in Israel.
newsitem.headline: Arafat to meet President Weizman in Israel.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat will meet Israeli President Ezer Weizman in the Jewish state on Tuesday, Israel Radio said on Monday.
Israeli and Palestinian officials were not immediately available to confirm the report.
The radio said Arafat would travel to the Israeli town of Caesaria by helicopter to meet Weizman -- whose presidential role in Israel is largely ceremonial -- at his home.
Weizman announced in August he would agree to Arafat's request for a meeting at a time when Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu still refused to set a date for talks with the Palestinian leader.
Netanyahu and Arafat met for the first time days later.
Israelis and Palestinians resumed peace talks on Sunday after an outburst violence in the West Bank and Gaza Strip in which 58 Palestinians and 15 Israelis were killed.
